verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 publishes a dedicated coding-agents use-case page. It describes a prebuilt template with browser tooling and snapshot-based parallel sandboxes, plus a documented integration for the coding agent LangChain Deep Agents Code. It also supports long-lived agent runtimes via the session supervisor. None of the evidence names Claude Code or Codex or gives a step-by-step recipe for running them, so delivery of the story as written is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit vendor recipes for Claude Code and Codex, install/auth steps for those agents, independent hands-on corroboration.
